title: leptorkis thwaitesii
intro: Leptorkis thwaitesii, commonly known as Leptorchis or Kandar, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asclepiadaceae. It is known to have various health benefits, including being used to treat fever, cough, and sore throat. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of Leptorkis thwaitesii include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
